اجتذبا (form VIII)
# اِجْتَذَبَا (ijtaḏabā) /id͡ʒ.ta.ða.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اُجْتُذِبَا (ujtuḏibā) /ud͡ʒ.tu.ði.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اِجْتَذِبَا (ijtaḏibā) /id͡ʒ.ta.ði.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
